newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S SUPER-G WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S SUPER-G WINNER.

text.p: The following is a profile of the women's super-giant slalom winner at the Alpine skiing world championships on Tuesday:
World Cup wins: 4. Downhill - Cortina (97), Cortina (96), Garmisch-Partenkirchen (94), Super-G - Cortina (97)

Other facts: Surprise winner of super-G gold medal at 1996 world championships in Sierra Nevada, Spain. That victory was the first by an Italian woman at a world championships since Paola Weisinger in 1932. Double Olympic bronze medallist at Lillehammer in downhill and super-G. Former junior world super-G champion. First downhill victory of her career came at race in which Austria's Ulrike Maier was fatally injured. Her downhill victory in Cortina in 1996 was the first by an Italian woman in her own country in 29 years.
